owner_instruction: coordinator 2026-10-06: compute the loader's required bandwidth against the >= 90 % of HBM peak load rule; half-rate 2x-wide datapath with proper CDC if that meets it, else pipeline +5-6 stages with kept copies

bandwidth.loader_role: host -> HBM ingress (model image load / store-back) and verify read-back; the per-token weight and KV reads stream from HBM through the service ports, not through the loader
bandwidth.host_ingress_basis: 64-bit host DMA beat per clk_host cycle, clk_host on the 1.2 GHz die clock in this view (ot_hbm_accel_dma64)
bandwidth.engine_side_basis: one 256-bit MREQ per clk_mem cycle (1.2 GHz)
bandwidth.rule_applicability: the >= 90 % HBM-peak rule binds weight / KV streaming loads; the loader's throughput is bounded by the host link (9.6 GB/s, 0.24 % of the die-column peak), so the rule does not bind it; the engines already run 4x faster than the host link can feed
bandwidth.half_rate_2x_wide: would meet the loader's own bandwidth (512 b at 0.6 GHz = 38.4 GB/s per die) but does not remove the failing class: the CRC-32 recurrence would fold 512 data bits per cycle (a deeper feed-forward tree into the same recurrence), and it adds a CDC pair per engine

failing_class: CRC-32 fold of a 256-bit beat into the running CRC in one cycle (crc <= crc_fold(crc, w)): ld3 CTS -4,229 ps at u_store crc_got, 42,497 violating endpoints; the unchanged host's own record tapeout_hbm_loader_20261004 SS -3,672 ps at 1.0 ns
decision: same clock, CRC pipelined by linearity: crc_fold(s, w) = crc_fold(s, 0) ^ crc_fold(0, w_lo) ^ crc_fold(0, w_hi); P1 register the beat, P2 the two 128-bit partials, P3 the recurrence (32 x 32 XOR matrix + one XOR); every CRC consumer waits for its pipeline to drain
cycle_cost: +2 cycles on each descriptor's completion (host LOAD / STORE status, memory verify / store completion record), 0 on throughput; off the per-token path
exactness: tb_loader_m_equiv.sv: unchanged vs margin host in identical environments, 3 seeds x 40 programs = 255 descriptors (LOAD verify on/off, wrong expected CRC, STORE back, misaligned), MREQ write stream, DMA write stream and every CSR except CYCLES identical; 3 mutants (dropped data partial, dropped verify partial, store drain gate removed) fail
next: margin routes ldm_*; any class still within 50 ps after the CRC fix gets stages in the same generator
